task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, head west. After that, make an attempt to go south. Following that, open the hatch. After that, make an effort to travel east. Then, open the gate. After opening the gate, make an attempt to move east. And then, make sure that the door is ajar. And then, take a trip south. If you can do that, try to go west. With that done, pick-up the soap dispenser from the floor of the laundromat. Got that? Good!
